purpose: Teach: 宝塚/グローブ/ジャンク/アリア/運勢/グレイ/悪人/グレン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「宝塚歌劇の公演を観に行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad mentioned wanting to go see a Takarazuka performance.
lines.style: Soft, affectionate recollection. Gentle opening. Warm tone, as if sharing something pleasant she noticed. Unhurried pace. Slight lingering on his father's kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから野球のグローブを頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad gave me a baseball glove!
lines.style: Bright, eager entrance. Quick attack on the excitement. Clear and unguarded joy. Slight lift at the end — offering this gift-moment to her. Boyish directness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ジャンクフードはたまににね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said junk food should only be once in a while.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact recollection. Quiet tone, caring without being preachy. Even pace. Trailing soft on the advice — she's noting something practical his father teaches.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「アリアを歌う動画」観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — I watched a video of Dad singing an aria with me!
lines.style: Bright, eager sharing. Quick, energetic delivery. Pride in the memory. Slight breathiness on the excitement. Open and transparent — this moment mattered to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「今日の運勢は大吉」って嬉しそうだったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was so happy — said today's fortune was the very best one.
lines.style: Warm amusement in the observation. Gentle, affectionate tone. Slow, savoring pace. Soft smile audible. She's delighted by his simple happiness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからグレイの帽子を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad gave me a gray cap!
lines.style: Bright, eager announcement. Quick, direct attack. Simple, uncomplicated joy. Boyish pride in the gift. Clean delivery — offering this to her straightforwardly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「悪人にならない正義感を持って」って教えて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad taught me something really important — to have a strong sense of justice without becoming cruel.
lines.style: Reverent, thoughtful recollection. Slow, careful pace. Quiet respect underlying. He's sharing something his father handed him. Tender, earnest delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「グレン・ミラー楽団の動画」聴いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis — Dad and I listened to a Glenn Miller Orchestra video together!
lines.style: Warm, contented recollection. Gentle, happy tone. Unhurried pace. Soft close on the togetherness of it. Boyish affection — sharing something precious.
